Officer's narrative
Officer's narrative: On the afternoon of the reported incident, I responded to a rear-end collision on a commercial
stretch of road in Katy, Texas. Driver 1 was stopped in traffic when the vehicle behind struck the rear bumper of
Driver 1's car. Driver 2 was the operator of the striking vehicle and stated that traffic ahead had stopped suddenly.
Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and said the impact pushed the head forward and back, which is consistent
with the injuries described. A Passenger was seated in the front right position of Driver 1's vehicle and was present at
the scene, and both the Passenger and Driver 1 confirmed this to me. I reviewed the scene photographs, which show
the rear damage on Driver 1's vehicle lining up with the impact from Driver 2's front end. No earlier damage to either
vehicle was known to the parties. No independent witnesses came forward. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on
the policy covering the vehicle involved. Both dirvers were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the scene
pending further review.
</page>
